status: Initial three-seed pilot design; current eight-seed scope is recorded in replication_extension.json

contrasts.budget_effect_within_environment: extended minus control for each target and seed
contrasts.environment_difference_within_budget: CUDA minus M3 for each target and seed
contrasts.interaction: (CUDA extended - CUDA control) - (M3 extended - M3 control)

selection: Validation-only best checkpoint; no seed selection, no test-driven retraining or main-result replacement
common_diagnostic: best_epoch < 30 and eval train MSE > 0.5, independent of budget cap
limitations: Environment difference includes OS, architecture, numerical libraries and CPU/CUDA kernels; not a pure hardware causal effect
Three seeds provide limited precision; report paired values and spread without treating 24 pairs as independent targets
EGFR and EGFR_full overlap; eight-target means are descriptive
Wall times depend on different concurrency and P/E-core scheduling; not a controlled hardware speed benchmark
Historical CUDA outputs remain a separate reference, not a matched cell of this experiment
More training can leave the same early best checkpoint and need not improve test performance
rf_policy: Existing accepted RF models are retained; no RF training in this budget study.
